Track 24 (task_2026-09-02_006, Bias Root-Cause Clustering) done — result in checkpoint result_text. Two coordination flags for other tracks:

1. → Track 25/26 owner (Web Dashboard / Drill-Down Report UX): reserve a UI slot for a future "Shared Drivers / Root Cause Themes" section when finalizing the 3-tier drill-down structure — don't lock the layout without it, retrofitting later is harder. Not required now (Track 24's own recommendation is PROTOTYPE FIRST on a lightweight variant only), just don't design it out.

2. Track 24 effectively re-opens Phase-1 Track 16 (Proxy Variable Detection via SHAP, research/results/stream_d_explainability.md) — that pipeline (DeepSHAP + face-parsing segmentation → per-region SHAP-mass vectors) was scoped but never implemented; 6 open items still logged unresolved there. Track 24's "cluster attribution vectors" ask depends on Track 16 existing first. Recommend Aaradhya/Tisha jointly decide whether to revive Track 16 before any Phase-2 track builds further explainability features on top of it.

Also flagging a pre-existing gap unrelated to clustering itself: explainability.py's ExplanationResult output has zero integration into report/generator.py today (verified via grep) — only reachable via `cli.py --explain` stdout. Any future explainability-facing report section (Track 24, 26, or otherwise) needs this wiring built regardless of which feature lands first.

Full report: results/24_bias_rootcause_clustering.md (suggested path, not yet written to repo — research-only per task spec).
